definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese soup consisting of dashi stock mixed with miso paste and various ingredients.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{味噌汁|みそしる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I have miso soup for breakfast.
examples.notes: In Japanese, soup is 'drunk' (飲む) not 'eaten'

examples.english: What ingredients would you like in your miso soup?

examples.japanese: ⟦お{袋|ふくろ}→お袋：10246_ofukuro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧といえば{味噌汁|みそしる}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: When it comes to mom's home cooking, it's miso soup.
examples.notes: お袋の味 means the taste of mother's cooking

examples.japanese: ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦わかめ→わかめ：10654_wakame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味噌汁|みそしる}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Miso soup with tofu and wakame is a classic combination.

examples.japanese: {味噌汁|みそしる}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{沸騰|ふっとう}→沸騰：03145_futtou⟧させると⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}んでしまう→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ので、⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れたら→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めるのが→止める：00678_tomeru⟧⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: If you let miso soup boil, the flavor of the miso will be lost, so the trick is to turn off the heat after adding the miso.

notes:
A staple of Japanese home cooking, served with almost every traditional meal. The type of ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧ varies by region:
- ⟦{白|しろ}みそ→白みそ：noentry⟧ (white miso) - milder, sweeter, popular in Kansai
- ⟦{赤|あか}みそ→赤みそ：noentry⟧ (red miso) - stronger, saltier, popular in Chubu
- ⟦{合|あ}わせみそ→合わせみそ：noentry⟧ (mixed miso) - combination

Common ingredients (⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧):
- ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧ (tofu)
- ⟦わかめ→わかめ：10654_wakame⟧ (wakame seaweed)
- ⟦ねぎ→ねぎ：05189_negi⟧ (green onion)
- ⟦{油揚|あぶらあ}げ→油揚げ：07477_aburaage⟧ (fried tofu)
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧ (daikon)
- ⟦なめこ→なめこ：noentry⟧ (nameko mushrooms)
- ⟦あさり→あさり：10207_asari⟧ (clams)

The expression 「{味噌汁|みそしる}で⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧を⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦{出直|でなお}してこい→出直す：06346_denaosu⟧」 (go wash your face with miso soup and start over) means 'come back when you've come to your senses'.
